skill.name: shopify-pos
skill.description: Guide for building Shopify POS (Point of Sale) UI extensions that integrate custom functionality into Shopify's retail interface. Use this skill when the user needs to create POS tiles, modals, blocks, or actions for the smart grid, cart, customer details, order details, product details, or post-purchase screens. Covers targets, components, APIs, and development workflow for POS app extensions.

generated_query: I need to build a custom interface for our retail point-of-sale system that lets cashiers apply a store loyalty discount directly from the home screen. The extension should show a tile labeled “Loyalty Discount” on the smart grid. When tapped, it should open a full-screen modal that displays the current cart total and a button to add a 10% discount line item. Once applied, the modal should close and the cart should update automatically. I already have a Shopify app set up with POS enabled, but I need guidance on creating the UI extension files, configuring the extension targets, and using the right APIs to interact with the cart. I also need to know which components to use for the tile and modal layout.

edit_instructions.target_text: await cart.applyCartDiscount({ type: 'percentage', value: 10, title: '10% Off' });
edit_instructions.rationale: Deleting the method to apply a cart discount means the skill no longer provides guidance on how to add the discount line item, which is the core requirement of the user query.

edit_instructions.target_text:

await cart.applyCartDiscount({ type: 'percentage', value: 10, title: '10% Off' });
